articles.detail: 5 cycles, 5 completed, avg 10 published/cycle (63 yesterday); 0 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. There are no active experiments and no pause gate, but two changes are still baselining: writer and editor moved to sonnet-5-5 on 2026-09-29, and commit 4d2027a3 rewrote select-prompt.md and other pipeline prompts at about 19:30 UTC today. That commit touched only the 22:00 cycle. A multi-source experiment started now would be confounded with both, so revisit about 2026-10-03 with three clean post-audit days.
weakestArea: Multi-source share is 25% against a 30% target (16 of 63 articles). It is down a fourth day in a row (43, 31, 26, now 25). The count of corroborated stories stayed at 16 while single-source regional and specialist pieces filled the rest. The 2026-05-09 politics/economy floor-3 experiment was reverted and must not be repeated. Raising TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH is off the table because of the NewsAPI budget, so the next lever to test is selector use of multiSourceStories, once the prompt audit has baselined.
watching: Hormuz: Iran says it received the US reply on its Hormuz conditions. This story is sourced only from state or advocacy outlets.
Iraq: the last US troops left through Erbil, following yesterday's exit story.
Russia–NATO: Moscow threatened NATO over Kaliningrad, and the Vatican envoy Zuppi visited Ukrainian prisoners in Moscow.
Iran: a school bombing in Minab killed children.
AI and tech: OpenAI delayed its IPO, launched Dots agents and accused Moonshot AI; America.gov launched a chatbot; ChatGPT invented witnesses in a New Mexico murder appeal.
Pentagon: Hegseth cut general officers by 20% and Musk joined a warfare study.
Nigeria: unions threatened a strike, and AI is tracking election results.
coverageGaps: The Regeni duplicate from 09-29 is still live: 2026-09-29-regeni-italy-convicts-egyptian-agents and 2026-09-29-regeni-egyptian-officers-sentenced-rome. sameEventDuplicates still does not catch cross-outlet, cross-title pairs, and one of the two should be removed.

Eight datelines are countries, regions or states rather than cities: India, Kazakhstan, Nigeria, South Africa, European Union, Spain, Panama and New Mexico. That is up from six yesterday. It breaks the city-only location rule, and missingDateline does not count it.
Latin America reached exactly 5% (Rio de Janeiro, Sabana de Torres, Panama). The Panama item is a science story with a country dateline, so mainland Latin American hard news is only two items.
Freshness was measured on only 5 of 63 articles, so a median of 0 says little.
Africa fell from 15 to 6, and Oceania is at 2 (both Sydney).
context: All five cycles completed. The average cycle dropped sharply to 805s from 1309s (selector 130s, writer 162s, editor 70s), so the writer slowdown from the sonnet-5-5 swap flagged yesterday did not persist. Science held at 8 from dedicated outlets (Nature, Nature Medicine, Quanta, Phys.org), and US datelines fell to 21%. Four stories were state-or-advocacy-only, the same as yesterday (Iran Hormuz reply, Jalud, the Zuppi visit, and the Anduril Ohio tax story).
